title: Interantral alveolar ridge splitting for maxillary horizontal expansion and simultaneous dental implant insertion: A case report
authors: Berger S, Hakl P, Sutter W, Meier M, Roland H, Bandura P , Turhani D . Ann Med Surg (Lond). 2019 ; 48:83-87.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The ARST in addition to simultaneous implant placement with a GBR can be successfully used for a full arch rehabilitation of the maxilla in a narrow alveolar ridge” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
